tagline: From 3 days to 4 hours: the credit memo, written by AI, signed by humans.
one_liner: CreditPilot drafts an MSME credit memo in minutes from bank statements, bureau and GST data, so NBFCs lend faster without lending worse.

slides.title: ₹25 lakh crore is waiting for a loan officer
slides.body: India's MSME credit gap is one of the largest in the world, and most of it is stuck in a PDF queue.

stats.label: of analyst time on data entry

slides.say: Sharks, every NBFC in this country has the same bottleneck. A small business owner uploads 12 months of bank statements, GST returns and a bureau report, and then waits three days while an analyst copies numbers into Excel.

slides.title: Underwriting is a copy-paste job
bullets: Analysts re-key 400+ data points per file
Every credit memo looks different, so risk committees cannot compare
slides.say: Sixty-two percent of an analyst's day is data entry. The judgment part, the part that actually protects the lender, gets maybe forty minutes.

slides.title: CreditPilot: an AI co-pilot for the credit desk
bullets: Reads statements, GST and bureau in under 90 seconds
Flags circular transactions, bounced EMIs and window dressing
Drafts a standard credit memo with every number linked to its source
Human-in-the-loop: the analyst approves, edits or rejects
slides.say: CreditPilot reads everything in ninety seconds, flags the fraud patterns, and drafts a full credit memo where every single number is clickable back to the page it came from. The analyst stays in charge. We just give them their day back.

slides.title: 6 pilots. 3 paying. ₹2.4 Cr ARR.
slides.say: We started eleven months ago. Six NBFCs are live, three are paying, and we have processed over eleven thousand loan files. Turnaround dropped from three days to four hours.

slides.title: Per-file pricing + platform fee
bullets: ₹1.5 lakh monthly platform fee per lender
Average paying lender: ₹6.7 lakh a month
slides.say: We charge a hundred and eighty rupees per file plus a platform fee. Our average paying lender is worth six point seven lakh a month to us.

slides.title: Built by a credit head and an ML engineer
slides.body: Neha ran MSME credit at a mid-size NBFC for nine years and signed off on 30,000 loans. Arjun built document AI at a global bank. We have lived this problem from both sides of the desk.
slides.say: I signed off on thirty thousand loans in nine years. I know exactly where the bodies are buried in a bank statement. Arjun built the engine that finds them.

slides.title: Not another bank-statement analyser
bullets: Statement analysers stop at data extraction
Large LOS vendors are slow, custom and expensive
We own the memo: extraction + fraud + judgment-ready draft
slides.say: Statement analysers give you a spreadsheet. Big platforms give you a twelve-month implementation. We give you a credit memo on day one.

ask.line: We are asking for ₹1.5 crore for 2% equity, and a shark who can open the doors of India's top NBFCs.

elevator_60s: CreditPilot turns three days of MSME underwriting into four hours. Our AI reads bank statements, GST and bureau data, flags fraud patterns, and drafts a credit memo where every number links to its source, while the analyst stays in control. Six NBFCs are live, three pay us, ARR is ₹2.4 crore at 78% gross margin. We want ₹1.5 crore to finish our model-risk audit and sell to twenty more lenders.
